name: Yoshino Sakura
source:
A mysterious girl who Kiyotaka and Ricca met. She didn't have any memories and had a mysterious cherry blossom branch. Since she had magical power she was taken in by Weather Vane.

[spoiler]
The relation of Sakura to [url=/c12804]Kiyotaka[/url] is that he is her grandfather and that [url=/c12822]Ricca[/url] is her grandmother.
[/spoiler]
